description: BigBang is a diverse team of young talented coders and researchers, seeking to innovate new and creative solutions to problems. With experience in events like FRC, Science Olympiad, VEX, and languages such as Python and C++, we hope to make a positive impact towards our community. Our interests are centered in web-development and astronomy, which is the reason why we chose the Planet X and SPHEREx challenge. With our tools and experience we know that we can make difference in this world.
